research_goal: Create backend-ready kickboxing clinch, knee, anti-clinch, and Muay Thai difference knowledge with strict rule-set awareness.

source_refs.title: GLORY Rules
source_refs.notes: Used for limited clinch and knee context in professional kickboxing.

source_refs.title: WAKO Rules
source_refs.notes: Used for differences between K1, full contact, low kick, kick light, and point fighting.

source_refs.title: IFMA Muay Thai Rules
source_refs.notes: Used as related-sport contrast for deeper clinch, knee, elbow, and sweep rules.

technical_principles.summary: Kickboxing clinch content must be selected by rule set. K-1-style users may need brief clinch knees and exits; point/full-contact users may not; Muay Thai users need a separate deeper clinch system.
Knees require posture, base, and safe entry/exit. Throwing knees while square, reaching, or off-balance creates counter and injury risk.

sport_training_rules.rule: Do not prescribe extended clinch systems as default kickboxing. Use clinch/knee content only when rule set, goal, and contact level support it.
recommended_action: For K-1 users, teach brief clinch posture, straight knee, frame, and exit.
For point/full-contact users, prioritize strike-defense-exit unless clinch is explicitly relevant.
For Muay Thai users, route to a Muay Thai-specific clinch domain when available.
blocked_action: Muay Thai clinch dominance as default kickboxing
hard clinch knees with hip, knee, or low-back pain

sport_training_rules.rule: Knee entries should be taught from stable base, guard, frame, or brief collar-tie/posture position, followed by immediate reset or exit.
recommended_action: Use shadow and pad knees before partner clinch knees.
Teach posture and frame before power.
Stop if hip flexor, knee, groin, low back, or head-contact risk rises.
blocked_action: fatigue knee circuits with poor posture
partner knees without clear contact control

planning_rules.rule: K-1-style programming should include brief-clinch knee entries, anti-clinch posture, and immediate exits in low doses before high-output rounds.
recommended_action: Use 2-4 short technical blocks of knee/frame/exit work.
Place knee mechanics before conditioning rounds.
blocked_action: late-session knee volume when hip/back fatigue is high

teaching_progressions.learning_goal: Teach a safe straight knee entry and exit for K-1-style kickboxing.
progression_steps: Shadow straight knee with posture and hand position.
Pad knee from stance without jumping.
Jab-cross to knee on pad with controlled step.
Brief frame or collar-tie position to knee on shield.
Knee then immediate exit or guard reset.
progression_signals: stable base before and after knee

sport_skill_assessments.summary: Assess whether K-1-style knee content is appropriate.
metrics: no hip, knee, groin, low-back pain escalation
hold_if: rule set does not permit knees
